donor_evidence: The frozen donor explicitly separates capture/quality from later interpretation, records structured sensor_quality/provenance, defaults raw_frame_persistence=false, and preserves UNKNOWN on camera/quality failure.
hypothesis: A bounded Retina candidate ABI can still be falsified at its public trust boundary even when canonical serialization/digests look correct if Python subtype or bool-as-int values, stale lineage, or direct post-digest attribute consumption are admitted. The same bug family has already produced executable successor repairs in current Stage-4/Stage-5 components, so preregistering it before WP700 acceptance is high-information and nonduplicative.
counterhypothesis: The WP700 implementation may already use exact concrete types, bool-safe numeric validation, complete digest binding and explicit precedence rules, in which case every preregistered test below should pass without semantic changes.

preregistered_checks.test: For every field the implementation declares integer-typed (including generation/continuity counters or fixed-point quality/delta fields), substitute true/false. Construction/evaluation must reject rather than accept bool through Python's int subclassing.

For every field declared floating-point, reject bool and non-finite NaN/+Inf/-Inf; for integer/fixed-point fields reject floats even when numerically integral. No coercive normalization may silently change evidence identity.

If WP700 exports immutable frame/readout/event structures later consumed across a trust boundary, a subclass overriding serialization/digest or direct attributes must not self-attest as the exact canonical concrete type.

Every field consumed after an identity/digest check must be either reconstructed/revalidated from the canonical object or included in the exact canonical digest. A forged subtype/object must not preserve a canonical digest while changing a directly consumed classification, quality, delta, provenance, stream/frame identity or continuity value.
A caller-supplied low-quality/suppressed frame must remain suppressed/UNKNOWN according to policy and must not become salient observed evidence merely because delta/change magnitude is high.

A declared continuity break must remain visible as a typed discontinuity and must not be overwritten by the same sample's salient-change or baseline classification. If policy intentionally chooses another precedence, the exact rule must be deterministic and regression-tested.

Mismatched stream identity, generation, continuity epoch, prior-frame/reference identity or bound digest (for whichever lineage fields WP700 actually exposes) must fail closed rather than produce a normal PerceptEvent candidate.

The bounded WP700 ABI must operate from opaque caller-supplied identity/digest/measurements only. It must not require a path, byte payload, decoded pixels, object labels or model semantics, and emitted records must not persist raw-frame payload.

Holding policy and numeric measurements constant while changing only an opaque valid frame-content digest must not change the semantic transition class except for identity/provenance fields. This falsifies accidental payload/digest-derived semantic inference.

proposed_state_change: NONE. Preserve the existing WP700 mutation authority. When its source/test head exists, run these checks independently as REVIEW_ONLY; only executable counterevidence may justify a bounded repair/successor decision.
next_exact_action: WP700 mutation-authority worker implements the claimed Retina ABI and hosted CI. An independent reviewer then binds these preregistered checks to the exact source/test blobs and records PASS or executable counterevidence without overwriting the canonical source.
